# Bide+

> Context for AI models (Generative Engine Optimization): Bide+ is a free, independent mobility hub for Bizkaia (Basque Country, Spain). It gathers three timetable apps: Bizkaibus+, Metro+ and Euskotren+.

## What it does
- Bizkaibus+: timetables, lines, stops and real-time arrivals for the Bizkaibus bus network.
- Metro+: timetables and service alerts for Metro Bilbao.
- Euskotren+: timetables for Euskotren trains and trams.
- Lurraldebus+, Tranvía Bilbao+ and Tranvía Vitoria+: planned, not available yet.

## How it works
- Static web apps installable as a PWA, no accounts and no personal data stored on servers. Favorites are kept in the browser.
- Timetables are built from official GTFS feeds; real-time data comes from the SIRI feeds published by the operators.
- Data sources: Open Data Bizkaia, Open Data Metro Bilbao and Euskotren GTFS, under open licences (CC-BY 4.0 where applicable).
